name: Seismic Slam
description: Slams the ground, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s

name: Arcane Lance
description: Fires a magical bolt at the target; deals 25% bonus damage to targets below 35% health

name: Cataclysm
description: Calls down a cataclysm, dealing magical damage in an area and stunning enemies for 1.2s

name: Stone Skin
description: Permanently gain +4 armor per rank while learned

name: Overcharge
description: While on, drain 8 mana/sec and gain +20% attack speed and +10 move speed; turns off when out of mana

name: Blink
description: Teleport to the target point

name: Shadow Strike
description: Hurls a dagger that deals magical damage, then slows the target and deals magical damage every 3s for 16s

name: QoP Blink
description: Teleports toward the target point, at least 200 and at most the maximum blink distance away

name: Scream of Pain
description: Sends a projectile at every nearby enemy, each dealing magical damage

name: Sonic Wave
description: Sends out a widening wave; each enemy struck takes pure damage 14 times over 1.4s and is knocked back

name: Shockwave
description: Sends out a wave of force that damages enemies in a line, pulls each one toward the wave and slows it briefly

name: Empower
description: Grants an allied hero or Magnus bonus attack damage and a cone cleave that melee heroes can use

name: Skewer
description: Rushes forward, goring enemies and dragging them, stunned, to the destination, where they take magical damage and are slowed

name: Reverse Polarity
description: Pulls nearby enemies to a point in front of Magnus, dealing magical damage and stunning them

name: Shrapnel
description: Launches a ball of shrapnel that showers the target area in explosive pellets after 1.2s, dealing magical damage every second for 10s and slowing enemies it hits

name: Headshot
description: Grants Sniper a chance to deal extra damage and briefly knock back the attacked enemy unit

name: Take Aim
description: Grants Sniper additional attack range

name: Assassinate
description: Locks onto an enemy unit; after a 2s aim, fires a devastating long-range shot that deals magical damage and mini-stuns the target. Cancelled if the target moves 600 beyond cast range

name: Earthshock
description: Leaps forward, then causes a powerful shock that damages and slows all enemy units around the landing point

name: Overpower
description: Greatly increases Ursa's attack speed for her next several attacks

name: Fury Swipes
description: Each attack on a target deepens its wounds: consecutive attacks on the same target deal increasing bonus physical damage. The stacks are lost if the target is not attacked again before the debuff expires

name: Enrage
description: Ursa removes all debuffs from herself, then takes greatly reduced damage and resists debuffs for a few seconds

name: Dark Pact
description: After a short delay, Slark sheds most debuffs and damages nearby enemies in quick pulses, healing for part of the damage dealt

name: Pounce
description: Slark leaps forward, damaging every enemy he passes; enemies near his landing point are leashed

name: Essence Shift
description: Each successful attack drains the target's attack damage and grants Slark agility; every stack wears off on its own

name: Shadow Dance
description: Slark hides in a cloud of shadows, becoming untargetable and gaining bonus move speed and health regeneration

name: Arctic Burn
description: Winter Wyvern takes flight, gaining attack range, faster attacks and phasing; her attacks burn and slow enemies

name: Splinter Blast
description: Launches a ball of ice at a unit that shatters on arrival, damaging and slowing every other enemy nearby

name: Cold Embrace
description: Encases an ally in ice: it cannot act, heals every second and is immune to physical damage

name: Winter's Curse
description: Freezes an enemy in place and dispels it; nearby enemies are compelled to attack it with bonus attack speed

name: Purification
description: Instantly heals an allied unit and deals pure damage to every enemy around it

name: Warding Bond
description: Binds Shadowheart to an ally: both gain armor and magic resistance, and all damage the ally takes is also dealt to Shadowheart

name: Spirit Guardians
description: Three spirits circle Shadowheart, dealing pure damage to each enemy they touch

name: Sharran Conversion
description: For a short time, enemy creeps that die near Shadowheart rise again as her allies at full health for 30 seconds

name: Rocket Barrage
description: Gyrocopter fires a barrage of rockets for 3 seconds; each rocket strikes a random nearby enemy for magical damage

name: Homing Missile
description: Launches a missile that waits briefly, then accelerates toward the target, dealing magical damage and stunning it; if the target dies first, the missile seeks the nearest enemy

name: Flak Cannon
description: For a limited number of attacks, each of Gyrocopter's attacks also strikes additional nearby enemies

name: Call Down
description: After a 2 second delay, missiles strike the target area, damaging and slowing enemies
